mapper.select: SELECT id, subject_key_hash, last_ip_hash, last_device_hash, password_failures, captcha_required, locked_until, last_failure_time, version FROM public.auth_login_failure WHERE subject_key_hash = #{subjectKeyHash} AND is_deleted = false LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.auth_login_failure ( subject_key_hash, last_ip_hash, last_device_hash, password_failures, captcha_required, locked_until, last_failure_time, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{subjectKeyHash}, #{ipHash}, #{deviceHash}, 1, false, NULL, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0, 0 ) ON CONFLICT (subject_key_hash) DO UPDATE SET last_ip_hash = EXCLUDED.last_ip_hash, last_device_hash = EXCLUDED.last_device_hash, password_failures = public.auth_login_failure.password_failures + 1, captcha_required = public.auth_login_failure.password_failures + 1 >= 3, locked_until = CASE WHEN public.auth_login_failure.password_failures + 1 >= 5 THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '15 minutes' ELSE public.auth_login_failure.locked_until END, last_failure_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, is_deleted = false, version = public.auth_login_failure.version + 1
mapper.update: UPDATE public.auth_login_failure SET password_failures = 0, captcha_required = false, locked_until = NULL, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE subject_key_hash = #{subjectKeyHash} AND is_deleted = false
